rationale: Tests recall of statin mechanism — the foundational pharmacological fact for dyslipidaemia therapy.
Tests understanding of PCSK9 inhibitor mechanism — a high-yield non-statin agent with a distinct mode of action.
Tests recall of loop diuretic mechanism at the nephron — essential pharmacological knowledge for managing fluid overload.
Tests understanding of contrasting electrolyte effects of thiazides vs loop diuretics — a clinically important prescribing distinction.
Tests understanding of ACE inhibitor-induced cough mechanism — a frequent clinical problem requiring drug switching.
Tests application of ARNI (sacubitril/valsartan) mechanism and indication — a key evidence-based therapy replacing ACEi in HFrEF.
Tests application of compelling indications — a key clinical pharmacology skill for matching antihypertensive to comorbidity.
Tests recall of ACEi/ARB contraindication in pregnancy — an absolute contraindication with serious teratogenic consequences.
Tests understanding of nitrate mechanism of action — key to explaining both anti-anginal benefit and the tolerance phenomenon.
Tests analysis of streptokinase contraindication after prior exposure — a high-stakes clinical decision in STEMI management.
Tests understanding of the four-pillar GDMT for HFrEF — a cornerstone of modern heart failure management.
Tests recall of the EF threshold that defines HFrEF — fundamental to applying the GDMT evidence base correctly.
Tests recall of the Vaughan-Williams classification — the organisational framework for antiarrhythmic pharmacology.
Tests analysis of adenosine's mechanism and its unique utility in SVT diagnosis/termination — a critical emergency use.
Tests understanding of warfarin monitoring parameter — essential knowledge for safe anticoagulation management.
Tests application of antiplatelet mechanism — understanding that aspirin irreversibly inhibits platelets, which has direct implications for surgical planning.
